document.abstract: Telecine systems are surveyed generally, and the various forms of flying-spot and camera-tube telecines are described, attention being given to their application to multistandard and color operation. In particular, reference is made to the ability of certain systems to operate alternatively on 50- or 60-fields/sec standards. Possible future developments are discussed, including the application to telecine systems of remote, semiattended and automatic operation.
